notes: Strip x 8870-10713 plus overlap from x 8570. Plate edge cuts: Buxton west of the pike, the stubs east of Marion (Buxton, Highland, Harper, Norwood, Harris), Carthage north, the east avenue's east side, the stubs east of the east avenue (Park, Kenilworth, Smith), and the bottom tabs (Ashland/Adams, Washington/Floral). NAME READINGS: (1) Montgomery: 'PIKE' printed north of Highland, 'MONTGOMERY' south; recorded as 'Montgomery Pike' for the whole line (no 'ROAD' seen in the strip). (2) The street from Buxton to Highland at x~9620-9410 prints 'STEWART' (lower) and 'PARK' (upper) in street lettering; recorded 'Stewart Park' - uncertain (could be Stewart with 'Park' belonging to a subdivision name). (3) 'Wilbert Avenue' north of Highland from letters W-I-L-B-E-R-T beside 'AVE' - uncertain. (4) Top avenue (y~243, Carthage to the pike) prints only 'AVENUE' -> '?'. (5) East avenue at x~10610-10510 (60 ft north of Park, 110 ft boulevard 28-54-28 with oval median islands south of Park) prints only 'AVE.' -> '?'. (6) The 80 ft avenue carrying the C.L.&N. tracks prints 'AVENUE' in the strip and 'LAFAYETTE' further SW at x~8100-8300 -> 'Lafayette Avenue'. (7) Ashland NE of Washington prints only 'AVE.'; house numbers run on from Ashland (4425-4445 -> 4500-4522), so recorded as Ashland. (8) Norwood Avenue from 'NORWOOD' (west) and 'AVE.' (east of Wesley). Not streets: unnamed 12 ft alley between lot rows at y~4890 (Smith to the east avenue), narrow 20 ft strip from Highland to Norwood behind the Montgomery lots at x~9150-9000, factory lanes west of Carthage, railroads. Big outlined letters (STEWART, F. ARNOLD'S TRACT, J.G. LANGDON'S, BOFINGER, HOPKINS, ...WOOD) are subdivision names.
